1. **“I Can’t Handle Change”** – the title track from Owen Evans’ solo project *I Can't Handle Change*【7†L50-L54】.  
2. **“Christmas Kids”** – a track from the same album that also went viral on TikTok in 2023【7†L55-L58】.  

* These songs were performed by **Owen Richard Evans**, who was the touring drummer for **Andrew Jackson Jihad** (the winner of the 2006 Phoenix New Times “Best Holy Local Band” award) from 2016 to 2021【4†L19-L22】【5†L49-L52】.
